metadata.description: One real tool turn through each selected pinned ACP adapter, against the operator's own Codex and Claude logins. Kept off the default test target because it spends their quota; a selected unavailable adapter fails explicitly.

The shell service's conformance rows (H01-H09, H08-H09 end to end through a scripted model and a real Tau agent host), extending native-process-core's provider rows: the real service over the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, negatives judged by bytes outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.

The shell's application and adversarial qualification rows (desktop shell blueprint W7: T01-T10, T12, T16, T19, the E rows the agent entrypoint reaches and the stress workloads S01-S04, the lifecycle and concurrency ones three times). A scripted model drives the official shell tool through a real Tau agent host, its registry and fixture admission, the shell service, the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash; negatives are judged outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.
